behaviors.description: Present tracked color-emotion appearances for interaction charge and pickup. Digging uses lime and pink; pickup uses orange and green. The edge vignette, pulse, smoothing and full-charge spin use the authored Cardinal equations. It does not assert that terrain was removed.
behaviors.selection: Layer-five interaction input drives charge and pickup feedback; inactive effects fade and release their Entity.

checks.expectation: No text, icons or buttons appear in the game. Only the requested two color pairs fade at screen edges without replacing world colors; the effect remains an Entity attributed to the calling Audicle.
checks.procedure: Check both pairs, hold/release, full-charge spin, fade to clear, native aspect and alpha blending on each selected graphics API; verify normal/error release and no stale Entity. Compilation is not rendering verification.
